description: This PHP source file generates a web page displaying detailed network connection information, including DPoE (Distributed Passive Optical Ethernet) and MTA (Multimedia Terminal Adapter) details, network status, and device info. It includes external PHP includes, functions for data processing, and dynamically populates HTML with device and network parameters.
